content:
Mika Chen: hi all, Mika here! first day on Eng-ML. super excited :) quick hurdle: I cant access the private repo redwood/models-core — getting a 403 after SSO. anyone know who to ping?

devex-bot: Welcome Mika! :tada: New hires should be auto-added to the engineering SSO groups within an hour. See onboarding doc: https://intranet/redwood/onboarding. If still blocked, tag eng-platform or reply here.

Sam Green: welcome @Mika :wave: Im your manager. Ill add a note to the access checklist. If you paste the error screenshot or the curl output it helps.

Mika Chen: pasted screenshot in thread. curl output: `curl -I https://git.redwood/internal/models-core` returns `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden`

Ravi Kumar: hey Mika, I handle repo perms. sometimes the SSO group sync lags. Ill force a sync now.

Petra Gomez: hi Mika! badge is ready at front desk, bring an ID. Also 11:00 onboarding coffee in the kitchen if you want to stop by.

Lina Torres: fun fact intro: I used to teach salsa dancing on weekends :dancer:. Welcome!

Ravi Kumar: synced groups at 1805551248, can you try again?

Mika Chen: re-ran curl at 1805551252 — now `HTTP/1.1 200 OK`. thanks Ravi!

Sam Green: great. Ive created a 30m intro with the team for 4pm and a 1:1 for tomorrow. Also, youll need access to the eval cluster; ping eng-infra if you cant ssh.

Mika Chen: one more quick ask: VPN client config — I installed `redwood-vpn` but kept getting TLS errors. any preferred client?

Ravi Kumar: we typically use the company package (managed via MDM). If youre on mac, try `brew install --cask redwood-vpn` then `redwood-vpn connect`. If that errors, DM eng-infra.

devex-bot: Remember to claim your equipment in the procurement portal: https://intranet/redwood/procurement/new-hires

Mika Chen: thanks all — grabbed badge, joined coffee, and the VPN connect worked after reinstall. excited to get started (also I collect vintage sci-fi paperbacks) :books:

Lina Torres: welcome again! we have a small bookshelf in 2B if you ever want to swap reads.

Petra Gomez: FYI payroll paperwork should hit your email today. Ping people-ops for any questions.

Sam Green: FYI team snack preference poll: salty vs sweet? Answer in thread.

Mika Chen: sweet (cookies)

Lina Torres: salty (chips) :potato:

Ravi Kumar: salty.

Sam Green: noting cookies for Mika and chips for Lina :) See you at the 4pm intro.
